label: Driver feel / small polish
meaning: Small feel change that needs clean back-to-back evidence.

label: Fine tuning
meaning: Useful trim when the main balance is already close.

label: Medium phase-specific lever
meaning: Noticeable change focused on one phase or transition.

label: Strong balance/platform lever
meaning: Large enough to move balance and create meaningful counter-effects.

label: Major package lever
meaning: Package-level change with broad coupling risk.
